title: Chapter 2: The Tortoise Shell
paragraphs: "School benefits are truly exceptional. A First-Tier High-Grade Spiritual Energy Cultivation Chamber with two free hours of use daily."

Chen Mobai recalled how, during the vacation, his mother had gritted her teeth and spent Merit Points to upgrade their home's Earth Vein Spiritual Energy to First-Tier High-Grade, all so he could break through. Even then, the spiritual energy density only reached 7, occasionally fluctuating to 8 or 9.
In contrast, Immortal Sect Fifth High School was built atop a Third-Tier Low-Grade Spiritual Vein, with three hundred cultivation chambers opened in total.
After all, these students were the future flowers of the Immortal Sect; they couldn't be starved of resources.

The three hundred cultivation chambers were divided equally among the first, second, and third-year students, corresponding to First-Tier Low, Mid, and High-Grade spiritual energy densities respectively.
The third-year students worked the hardest, and the spiritual energy density in their chambers was already at the peak of the First-Tier.
The cultivation chambers were spartan: square rooms with a single meditation cushion on the bluestone floor at the center.
Wasting no time, Chen Mobai set his phone aside, activated the assisted cultivation recording mode, and settled onto the cushion to begin refining spiritual energy.

Having just broken through to the Fifth Layer of Qi Refinement, and with his cultivation still unstable due to relying on medicinal pills, Chen Mobai refrained from practicing the Five Elements Internal Cultivation Technique during the two-hour session. Instead, he focused solely on the most fundamental Qi Nourishment Technique.

Streams of warmth flowed through his meridians as the faint white spiritual energy in the cultivation chamber, nearly condensing into mist, surged into his nose and mouth like a dragon, merging with his refined spiritual power. Slowly, the energy melded, gradually transforming into his own genuine strength.
He immediately became completely absorbed in the sensation, utterly lost in it.
Time slipped by slowly.

The Soul-Waking Charm in the cultivation chamber jolted Chen Mobai awake from his practice. Though reluctant, he remembered the classmates who had been waiting outside for their turn and reluctantly grabbed his phone. He shuffled out of the chamber, taking small steps.
The moment he emerged, a female classmate at the end of the line rushed in, swiping her card and closing the door in a single smooth motion.
Chen Mobai wasn't alone in his reluctance. All ninety-nine students from Immortal Sect Fifth High School who had participated in the session exited the cultivation chambers with similar reluctance.
Among them was Chen Mobai's deskmate, Lu Hongsheng.
"Hey, you got lucky! You managed to snag one of the first slots."
After exchanging greetings, Chen Mobai noticed a gloomy, brooding look in Lu Hongsheng's eyes.
"You won't believe what I just saw," Lu Hongsheng blurted out.
Knowing Lu Hongsheng couldn't keep secrets for long, Chen Mobai waited patiently. Sure enough, he spilled the beans himself after a moment.
"I saw Song Zheng enter the Second-Tier Spiritual Vein's cultivation chamber."
"The Second-Tier Spiritual Vein? Aren't those reserved for teachers? Who let Song Zheng use their chamber?"
The school naturally had not only cultivation chambers for students but also high-end chambers exclusively for teachers.

Apart from the Third-Tier Cultivation Chamber reserved for the principal, a Foundation Establishment cultivator, the ten Second-Tier Cultivation Chambers required even teachers to queue up and wait their turn.
Song Zheng's access to a Second-Tier Chamber meant a teacher had relinquished their cultivation resources to him.

"Who else could it be but Old Man Ding? He's failed his Foundation Establishment twice and doesn't have much time left. He's poured his heart and soul into teaching, and when he saw Song Zheng's potential to enter one of the Four Great Dao Academies, he gave up his Second-Tier chamber allocation to him."
As Lu Hongsheng spoke, envy, jealousy, and resentment burned within him.
He wished he were Song Zheng.
"This is so unfair! Why isn't the school doing anything about it?"
Their conversation caught the attention of several classmates nearby. One of the boys, his face flushed with indignation, exclaimed, "Absolutely outrageous!"
While true fairness was a rare commodity in society, schools generally maintained a semblance of impartiality on the surface.

For a teacher to allocate cultivation resources to a student—even if it was from the teacher's own share—was already unfair, given that the cultivation chambers ultimately belonged to the school. Reporting this to the academic affairs office would at least cause a stir.

"What do you know?" a female classmate retorted, her expression sour. "I heard Song Zheng formally became Teacher Ding's disciple during the vacation. It's officially recorded in the Hall of Inheritance at the Immortal Gate Ministry of Education. They're now master and disciple. Even the academic affairs office can't interfere when a master shares resources with their apprentice."
Song Zheng possessed striking looks and was a young prodigy, making him quite popular among the girls.
Chen Mobai couldn't help but feel envious as well.

If he cultivated on a Second-Tier Spiritual Vein for a semester, he was confident he could reach the Sixth Layer of Qi Refinement. Students at that level couldn't enter the Four Great Dao Academies, but they could likely get into a Second-Tier Dao Academy, and Third-Tier Dao Academies were easily within reach.
He also possessed a True Spiritual Root, so why hadn't any teachers noticed him?
It could only be said that even among True Spiritual Roots, there were hierarchies.
"You guys keep chatting. I'm heading home. See you tomorrow."
Chen Mobai still harbored ambition. Though he felt a pang of injustice, he had no desire to get involved in their arguments.

After his free time in the school's cultivation chamber expired, he rushed home. His mother had rarely splurged, purchasing six months' worth of a First-Tier High-Grade Spiritual Vein just to help him score well on the college entrance exams.
He couldn't let that go to waste.
When he returned home, the house was empty.
His parents were working hard to support the family, especially after leasing the Spiritual Vein for half a year. Their overtime had increased, and they wouldn't return until late each night.
Chen Mobai first cooked a pot of Spiritual Rice. Then, in his mother's workshop, he cut large sheets of yellow paper into standard-sized talisman paper: 12cm long and 6cm wide.
By the time the Spiritual Rice was cooked, Chen Mobai had already cut over a hundred blank talisman papers.
He counted out twelve sheets per dozen, neatly stacked them, and bound each dozen with a specially crafted Spiritual Cord. He arranged six dozens into two stacks and placed them in a packaging box.

Each large sheet of talisman paper cost one Merit Point. After cutting and packaging, they could be sold for two Merit Points, translating to a profit of approximately one Merit Point per box for his labor.
To supplement the household income, Chen Mobai took on odd jobs within his capabilities.

He neatly arranged the two newly packaged boxes of talisman paper on the table, adding them to the eight boxes he had prepared earlier, making a total of ten boxes that completely filled the large table.
He took over a dozen photos from various angles with his phone, then selected the best ones and posted them on the Immortal Sect's official online trading platform.
Typically, bids would trickle in over the next week, after which Chen Mobai would choose the highest offer and sell the lot.
Unable to afford transmission fees, he restricted his sales to face-to-face transactions within Danxia City.
Thanks to the city's advanced transportation system, his student card granted him free access to public transit.
After finishing his meal of plump, jade-like Spiritual Rice, Chen Mobai cast a Cleansing Spell to clean the pots and pans before retreating to his bedroom.
Although his family had specially built a cultivation chamber above the mouth of the Earth Vein Spiritual Energy conduit, Chen Mobai still preferred to practice Qi Refinement in his own room.

After all, simply leaving the cultivation chamber door open would allow First-Tier High-Grade spiritual energy to permeate every room in the house. Even with the windows open, the Spirit-Sealing Restriction that enveloped the entire residence would firmly lock the Earth Vein Spiritual Energy inside, preventing any waste.
Naturally, this also meant that the spiritual energy concentration in the house was lower compared to the cultivation chambers at school.
But Chen Mobai was already more than satisfied.

Suppressing the urge to check his phone and watch livestreams, he banished thoughts of those dancing and singing fairy maidens, calmed his mind, and sat cross-legged on his bed, preparing to cultivate. Suddenly, his gaze fell upon the tortoise shell on his bedside table.
"Mom's really something, bringing this cursed thing over here!"
